front: When and where was the Victoria Falls conference?
back: 25-26 August 1975, in a railway carriage on the Victoria Falls bridge; it failed.

front: Why did the Geneva conference (1976) fail?
back: Disagreement over the transition, especially control of the army and police.
The agreement of 3 March 1978 between Smith and Muzorewa, Sithole and Chirau, excluding the Patriotic Front.
1 June 1979, with Bishop Muzorewa as Prime Minister.

front: When did the Lancaster House Conference meet, and when was it signed?
Name three constitutional terms of Lancaster House.
back: 20 of 100 seats reserved for whites for 7 years; Bill of Rights; willing-seller, willing-buyer land acquisition for 10 years.
The war, Frontline and Commonwealth pressure, Britain's direct control of the transition, and compromise on land.
Vorster and Kaunda's joint effort to ease tension and push Smith and the nationalists into talks.
